mapper.select: SELECT customer_code, customer_name, business_no, email, phone, updated_at FROM erp_customer WHERE customer_code = #{customerCode}
SELECT product_code, product_name, category, unit_price, active, updated_at FROM erp_product ORDER BY product_code
SELECT order_no, quote_no, customer_code, order_date, status, total_amount FROM erp_sales_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT order_no, line_no, product_code, quantity, unit_price FROM erp_sales_order_item WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY line_no
SELECT delivery_no, order_no, shipped_at, carrier, tracking_no, status FROM erp_delivery WHERE delivery_no = #{deliveryNo}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO erp_quote (quote_no, customer_code, quote_date, status) KEY(quote_no) VALUES (#{quote.quoteNo}, #{quote.customerCode}, #{quote.quoteDate}, #{quote.status})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_quote_item(quote_no, line_no, product_code, quantity, unit_price) VALUES(#{quoteNo}, #{line.lineNo}, #{line.productCode}, #{line.quantity}, #{line.unitPrice})
mapper.update: MERGE INTO erp_sales_order(order_no, quote_no, customer_code, order_date, status, total_amount) KEY(order_no) VALUES(#{order.orderNo}, #{order.quoteNo}, #{order.customerCode}, #{order.orderDate}, #{order.status}, #{order.totalAmount})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_sales_order_item(order_no, line_no, product_code, quantity, unit_price) VALUES(#{orderNo}, #{line.lineNo}, #{line.productCode}, #{line.quantity}, #{line.unitPrice})

INSERT INTO sync_history(direction, entity_type, external_key, operation, status, message, created_at) VALUES(#{direction}, #{entityType}, #{externalKey}, #{operation}, #{status}, #{message}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, direction, entity_type, external_key, operation, status, message, created_at FROM sync_history ORDER BY id DESC
